summary: Ran the PR smoke check and day-01 regression scenarios on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844). Add, trim, empty/spaces rejection, toggle done, delete, keyboard use, long titles, and rapid clicks all behaved as specified with no console errors. No bugs found; known-bugs list was empty.

scenarios.title: Page load shows Todos heading, form, empty state, no console errors
scenarios.notes: Desktop and mobile: heading, New todo, Add, No todos yet., Format version 1; 0 console errors.

scenarios.title: Add a todo with the Add button
scenarios.notes: Todo appears at end of list; field clears.

scenarios.title: Add a todo by pressing Enter
scenarios.notes: Works on desktop and mobile; second item keeps order.

scenarios.title: Reject empty and spaces-only titles
scenarios.notes: Add click and Enter with empty/spaces leave list unchanged.

scenarios.title: Trim surrounding spaces on add
scenarios.notes: '  Buy milk  ' and '  Trim me  ' stored without padding.

scenarios.title: 500-character title stays usable
scenarios.notes: Added on both viewports; no horizontal overflow; layout wraps.

scenarios.title: Add many todos quickly in order
scenarios.notes: 20 desktop todos and 10 mobile todos kept insertion order.

scenarios.title: Mark done and undo
scenarios.notes: Checkbox toggles checked state; done styling applies and clears.

scenarios.title: Delete a todo in the middle of the list
scenarios.notes: Only the targeted item is removed; neighbors remain.

scenarios.title: Delete all todos shows empty state
scenarios.notes: 'No todos yet.' returns after clearing the list.

scenarios.title: Footer shows Format version 1
scenarios.notes: Visible on load and after interactions on both viewports.

scenarios.title: Keyboard-only add, toggle, and delete
scenarios.notes: Tab to field, Enter to add, Space on checkbox, Enter on Delete all work.

scenarios.title: Mobile smoke and regression (390x844)
scenarios.notes: Full smoke plus edge cases; no horizontal overflow; no console errors.

scenarios.title: Reload clears todos (intended)
scenarios.notes: Reload mid-session returns empty list as documented; not reported as a bug.
